entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Care to explain?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I believe in what I wrote... "The Phantom[n]Thieves are just."

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Have you figured out who they are?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No, I'm nowhere close.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: However, after considering all the facts,[n]I concluded there are no errors in their[n]acts or principles.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thus, upon deeming them to be on the[n]side of justice, I have decided to end my[n]investigation.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: But that's impossible!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Impossible? May I see the evidence you[n]have that leads you to believe so?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I was just speaking to the director of[n]a prestigious college about your letter[n]of recommendation too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There will be no need for that. I intend[n]on getting into a good college by my[n]own merit.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please excuse me.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Hey, we're not done here!

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Sir, it's me. I apologize for bothering you[n]like this...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: About that...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Yes, I am making progress. However,[n]I have stumbled upon some difficulties...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Still, why would someone as important[n]as you be interested in a petty case like[n]this?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: N-No! That's not what I meant! I will[n]investigate with all the resources[n]available to me.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Of course... Um, I should be able to[n]let you know relatively soon. Yes, I will[n]bring good news...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Well then, thank you for your—

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Dammit...
